findings.evidence: `TauCeti` line 72 has `{J : E →ₗ[R] E}`; Mathlib `Submodule.equivMapOfInjective` is declared for `f : M →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] M₂` at `Mathlib/Algebra/Module/Submodule/Map.lean:146`.
findings.fix: Generalize the signature to `{F} [AddCommGroup F] [Module R F] {f : E →ₗ[R] F} (hf : Function.Injective f) (L : Submodule R E) : finrank R (L.map f) = finrank R L`, or avoid adding the wrapper.
findings.issue: `Submodule.finrank_map_of_injective` is stated only for an endomorphism `J : E →ₗ[R] E`, although the Mathlib API it wraps works for injective maps into an arbitrary codomain.

findings.fix: Remove it, make it private if only needed locally, or prove it as a thin convenience wrapper from `LinearMap.injective_of_comp_eq_id` instead of duplicating the argument.
findings.issue: `LinearMap.injective_of_comp_self_eq_neg_id` is an unused public special case of the existing left-inverse criterion, adding duplicate API rather than proving or using the natural general result.

summary: The main totally-real finrank statements are at the intended injective-endomorphism level, but the PR adds public helper API at an unnecessarily special level instead of using or matching existing Mathlib generality.
